lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Wraithwood Estates! Every resident died centuries ago, but the HOA dues are collected MONTHLY.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What happens if a ghost doesn't pay?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: They get haunted. Yes, ghosts haunting ghosts. It's haunting all the way down, hero.

lines.speaker: HOA Banshee
lines.text: YOOOOUR FEEEENCE... IS FOUR INCHES... TOO TAAAAALL.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We don't have a fence. We don't live here.

lines.speaker: HOA Banshee
lines.text: NONRESIDENT VIOLATIONS... ARE DOUBLE.
The community clubhouse. Candles float. The minutes from 1744 are still being read.

lines.speaker: Chairman Poltergeist
lines.text: NEW BUSINESS: the living have entered the neighborhood. All in favor of destroying them?
A thousand spectral hands rise.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Point of order! POINT OF ORDER!! Oh no, he has the gavel—

lines.speaker: Chairman Poltergeist
lines.text: Motion... to adjourn... FOREVER...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The ghosts are FREE! They're painting their doors WHATEVER COLOR THEY WANT! That one's doing a mural! It's hideous! It's BEAUTIFUL!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Somewhere out there, a shed is finally being built.
In the clubhouse basement, spectral workers gather around a very alive wolf.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: Ghost Local 1744 is hereby chartered! Dues: one rattle per month. First demand: haunting is WORK, and work gets WAGES.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He unionized the DEAD. The man cannot be stopped.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: Wolf, actually. And no. I cannot.
The air shimmers with an abstract dread. Numbers float in it. They are going up.

lines.speaker: The Property Value
lines.text: I MUST RISE. IF YOU REMAIN, I CANNOT RISE. THE MATH IS SIMPLE. THE MATH IS CRUEL.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're not even residents.

lines.speaker: The Property Value
lines.text: YOU ARE FOOT TRAFFIC. FOOT TRAFFIC IS A MIXED INDICATOR.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero... the casserole dish. It's on our doorstep. We don't HAVE a doorstep. We don't have a DOOR.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Bring it. We'll return it to the Chairman.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: RETURN the dish?! Nobody has EVER returned the dish. This changes everything. This is our secret weapon.
